She had always been fascinated by the weather, but never in a million years had she thought she could control it.\n\nChapter 2: The Drought\n\nMaya returned to her apartment, still feeling overwhelmed by what had happened. Maya knew - a drought had hit the city.\n\nWhen Maya went to school that day, she heard the news that the drought was getting worse every day. People were starting to panic, and the government was rationing water. The sky was dark, and Maya could feel the energy in the air. She closed her eyes and focused, and soon, she could feel the clouds forming. She used her power to control the wind, and within minutes, rain began to fall.\n\nMaya was careful to create a balanced storm - enough rain to replenish the water supply, but not so much that it would cause flooding.
